stage: 5c-3 P2-51 two-ball collection and ballistic delivery
purpose: Measure sequential and side-by-side two-ball handling on the frozen P2-51 R75/42-degree setup without changing geometry or contact calibration.
supersedes: The first P2-55 empty_y0 and empty_y50 runs were one-ball P2-51 repetitions and are excluded from this matrix.

frozen_setup.geometry: P2-40 frozen launcher plus P2-51 basket and R75/42-degree ski-jump

criteria.name: all_balls_nip_capture
criteria.rule: both incoming balls cross launcher-local X=-33 mm

criteria.name: all_balls_ski_takeoff
criteria.rule: both incoming balls clear the P2-51 ski tip toward -X

criteria.name: all_balls_basket_entry
criteria.rule: both incoming balls enter the P2-51 basket aperture

criteria.name: all_balls_retained
criteria.rule: both incoming balls remain in the empty basket with final mean speed <=0.25 m/s

criteria.name: lidar_margin
criteria.rule: each ball top remains at or below Z380 before first basket entry

criteria.name: d5065_contact_current
criteria.rule: absolute modeled current <=20 A per motor

criteria.name: d5065_contact_torque
criteria.rule: absolute modeled torque <=0.62 N m per motor

criteria.name: forbidden_contact
criteria.rule: no incoming ball or launcher contact with chassis, arch, camera or LiDAR

criteria.name: finite_state
criteria.rule: no NaN or Inf in telemetry

required_diagnostics: rpm drop attributable to each ball contact window
time after each ball contact to recover both wheels to 95 percent of commanded rpm
takeoff speed for each ball and minimum second-ball takeoff speed
first side-by-side pair contact and governing nip free width versus 2x67 mm
limitations: deterministic Gazebo comparison, not a Monte Carlo tolerance study
native DART ball-ball and basket contact are not physically calibrated
no capacity, pile, 5d, STL or production-stack claim
